vessels.name: Left internal mammary artery graft
vessels.source: Measured then corrected (tools/anatomy/grafts.py; docs/research/grafts/GRAFTS-geometry.md): ostium where the BodyParts3D 4.0 left internal thoracic artery (FJ1972) leaves the left subclavian (FJ3479); chest-wall course = the FJ1972 centreline moved laterally to the published distance from the shipped left sternal edge (10.5 mm 1st interspace, 13.5 mm 2nd-3rd; Henriquez-Pino 1997, Bayrak 2026) and kept 2-4 mm behind the shipped cartilages; leaves the chest wall below the manubriosternal junction (CT description, G gap 4); free course with a gentle redundant bow (path 1.1-1.25 x the chord, Fan 2017 chord/arc 0.8-0.9) in front of the pulmonary trunk over the RV outflow, faired so no bend is tighter than 12 mm before the last 6 mm (18 mm where it turns onto the heart); last 15 mm seated on the heart; end-to-side on the mid LAD at ~30 deg with a ~5 mm confluent toe. Calibre tapers steadily 2.9 -> 2.7 -> 2.4 mm (VMR 2.5/2.4/2.4; native ITA CT 3.47 -> 2.53; angiographic anastomosis 2.1-2.5 mm). BodyParts3D (c) DBCLS, CC BY 4.0.

vessels.name: Saphenous vein graft to the first obtuse marginal
vessels.source: Synthesised on the shipped heart (tools/anatomy/grafts.py; docs/research/grafts/GRAFTS-geometry.md): ostium on the shipped ascending aorta at the VMR group-mean height converted to a proportion of this aorta (STJ -> brachiocephalic), VMR mean azimuth and take-off, 10 mm hood within 40 deg of the wall normal; course leftward over the top of the pulmonary trunk behind the LIMA, down lateral to the left atrial appendage onto the lateral wall; last 25 mm seated on the epicardium, end-to-side at the VMR mean angle (clipped 30-45 deg). Calibres Fan 2017 CT at 1 y (3.3 / 4.5 / 4.0 mm), hood 4.8 mm. Clearances: cavities >= 1.5, PT >= 2, native lumens >= 3 mm.

vessels.name: Saphenous vein graft to the posterior descending artery
vessels.source: Synthesised on the shipped heart (tools/anatomy/grafts.py; docs/research/grafts/GRAFTS-geometry.md): ostium on the shipped ascending aorta at the VMR group-mean height converted to a proportion of this aorta (STJ -> brachiocephalic), VMR mean azimuth and take-off, 10 mm hood within 22 deg of the wall normal; course down over the right atrium outside (superficial to) the native RCA in the right AV groove, round the acute margin onto the diaphragmatic surface; last 25 mm seated on the epicardium, end-to-side at the VMR mean angle (clipped 30-45 deg). Calibres Fan 2017 CT at 1 y (3.3 / 4.5 / 4.0 mm), hood 4.8 mm. Clearances: cavities >= 1.5, PT >= 2, native lumens >= 3 mm.

hardware.source: No ostial markers (used in a minority, 24 % in one series; A §5). Sternal wires (round 6, against four chest films: Radiopaedia 'CABG on a chest film' and 'CABG 1 month post-op', PMC6016071 f0010, Radiopaedia 'LAD surgical clips'): 6 of 0.9 mm (USP 6-7): 2 trans-manubrial loops 34-37 mm wide (through the bone), 2 simple peristernal loops (interspace 2 and the upper part of 3) and 2 figure-of-eight peristernal wires in the lower body (passes behind the sternum through interspaces 3+4 and 4+5, the two anterior limbs crossed at the midline; loop entries carry 'shape'). Peristernal wires run 1.5 mm outside the shipped sternum (width = sternum + 3 mm); simple loops are tilted 5-10 deg off the plane normal to the sternal axis. Each wire has one twisted stalk (two strands, 6-12 mm, irregular twist, 5-15 deg off the sternal axis, lying on the bone; entries with part 'twist'). Count per B §5 / G gap 5; spacing unpublished. Clips: small Ti haemoclips (3.55 / 5.8 mm, FDA GUDID), closed: two 3.5-4.5 mm jaws 8 deg off the clip axis (two entries per clip, same 'clip' id), within 2 mm of their vessel: 5 on the LIMA pedicle 22 mm apart, 2 on the empty ITA bed, 1 on the SVG-OM and 2 on the SVG-PDA; counts and spacing are unpublished (inference; B S12, G gap 5, COMPARISON-sheet fix 4).
